criteria.point: Correct completion of the FUNCTION header (parameter with type, RETURNS STRING)

FUNCTION TempCheck(Position : INTEGER) RETURNS STRING
    DECLARE Temperature : REAL
    DECLARE Response : STRING

    ENDIF

    RETURN Response

items.final_answer:
FUNCTION PartSearch(Target : STRING) RETURNS INTEGER
   Left <- 1
   Right <- 1000000
   WHILE Left <= Right
      Mid <- (Left + Right) DIV 2      // or Mid <- DIV(Left + Right, 2)
      IF PartName[Mid] = Target THEN
         RETURN Mid
      ELSE
         IF PartName[Mid] < Target THEN
            Left <- Mid + 1
         ELSE
            Right <- Mid - 1
         ENDIF
      ENDIF
   ENDWHILE
   RETURN -1
ENDFUNCTION
